mappings.requirement_text: CC7.2: The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of security incidents.
CC7.1: Configuration monitoring detects and evaluates infrastructure changes in a timely manner.
CC6.7: The transmission, movement and removal of data is controlled and encryption protected.
CC6.1: Logical access security measures protect against threats including key management.
CC6.1: Logical access security software restricts logical access to authorized users.
CC6.6: Logical access to network infrastructure is restricted to authorized users.
CC7.2: Anomalies are recorded, surfaced and escalated to the appropriate function.
